head: Adobe Premiere mobile adds songs from Universal and Warner Music
dek: Adobe's free Premiere mobile video editor will let you add up to 60 seconds of songs from Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group to your videos. Adobe says it's coming soon.
details: You can browse trending songs, preview them, filter by genre or length and bookmark favourites; templates come with music already paired. The licences cover personal, non-commercial use only. Videos can be exported directly to licensed social platforms. The app is free; some AI features need paid credits.
where: Premiere mobile, coming soon; personal use only
means: If you edit social videos on your phone, you'll be able to use popular songs without worrying about the licence for personal posts.
todo: Install or update Premiere mobile; Adobe says people who have the app now will be among the first to get it. For business videos, use Adobe Stock Audio instead.
